**Data quality:** 14/14 Module 0 checks clean (see data_quality_report.md).

_Two revenue bases, both stated wherever used: segment revenue = loan interest + transaction fees (account fees are bank-wide and not split by segment; segment-basis total = $2,920,882.43); per-customer revenue (customer_value.csv, top-decile share) also includes each customer's own account fees, so it adds back to total revenue. Assumptions: loan interest = outstanding balance × product rate, spread evenly across months for the trend; charge-off proxy = 90+ DPD share. Synthetic portfolio data._
